title: Trustworthy AI
lines: Trustworthy AI teaches how to justify reliance on an entire deployed system.
It connects reliability, fairness, security, and human oversight through explicit assurance claims.
The central question is what evidence supports a particular use under stated conditions.
A model score cannot answer that question alone.
Readers learn how to make confidence inspectable, bounded, and renewable when systems change.

title: Follow the failure across layers
lines: The same visible failure can originate in data, a model, surrounding software, or organizational practice.
The book separates those four layers before choosing an intervention.
A changed index or review policy can alter behavior without replacing the model.
Looking only at model accuracy would miss those consequential changes.
The course therefore organizes technical methods around the failures they are intended to prevent.

title: Confidence has conditions
lines: An assurance case connects a bounded claim with evidence and explicit assumptions.
It also records observations that would weaken or invalidate the claim.
A system update can make earlier evidence insufficient for continued reliance.
The book connects monitoring, adversarial tests, fallback, and human escalation with this changing argument.
Trust becomes a reasoned operational judgment rather than a permanent badge.

title: Read for justified reliance
lines: Begin with a specific decision the system is allowed to influence.
Follow the course from system boundaries through uncertainty, fairness, security, and assurance.
The later chapters show how these concerns interact in generative and agentic systems.
Trustworthy AI offers a connected engineering method rather than a promise of certainty.
Read it to make the reasons for reliance visible, testable, and open to revision.
